items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Joe Thomas with Jimmie Lunceford, Pres. This was just about every night.

ctx.x: Oh, it was after that. I think Hawk recorded Body and Soul after the -- you know, he came back -- he came to New York during the war, World War II. That's why he came back, that's what he and Benny Carter first came back from Europe, you know, because of the war, and Hawk recorded this after he came back. [1939] That I'm sure of. But speaking of that during that time when Hawk and Benny Carter came back, we used to go to a club called -- what was the name of this club? The Victoria Bar and Grill. And all the…
